moaSummary.value: Artemisinin-class antimalarial used in severe malaria pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, route sequence, or step-down schedule; confirm against current SA STG/EML and the labelled product.

Fixed-dose ACT used in uncomplicated falciparum malaria pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent weight-band doses, food timing hours, or course length; confirm against current SA STG/EML and the labelled product.

Benzimidazole anthelmintic used against selected helminth infections — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, duration, or pregnancy rule; confirm against current SA STG/EML and the labelled product.

Anthelmintic used in schistosomiasis and selected cestode pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or food-timing rule; confirm against current SA STG/EML and the labelled product.

Polyene antifungal used in serious fungal and selected opportunistic infection pathways — educational framing only. Formulation matters (conventional vs lipid); Materia does not invent a dose, premedication, or monitoring schedule.
Beta-lactam antibiotic that inhibits bacterial cell-wall synthesis — hospital EML workhorse for selected infections. Educational framing only; Materia does not invent a dose, interval, or duration.
First-generation cephalosporin used in selected infections and surgical-prophylaxis contexts — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, redosing interval, or allergy algorithm.

Natural penicillin inhibiting bacterial cell-wall synthesis — classic EML agent for selected susceptible infections. Educational framing only; Materia does not invent a dose, unit schedule, or infusion rate.
